title: Occupant sway direction correctness
simLoop: No sim change — OccupantMesh is still presentation-only (T-006). The downwind lean is now composed as quaternions (yaw first, world-axis lean outermost) instead of Object3D.rotateOnAxis after the yaw, so the lean axis stays fixed in world space regardless of each cell's random facet-spin yaw. swayTilt now holds a lean (70% of peak amplitude) with a minority flutter (30%) riding on top, instead of a symmetric sine through zero.
gameLoop: Every visible shoot leans the same horizontal direction under one wind vector — the meadow reads as plants bent by the wind, not as a field of independently animated characters.
notebookSeed: The grass leans one way, the way the wind is blowing.
tierO: no owner-only question — corrects L4's own D-007 clip verdict to match the code; owner screenshot was the trigger. Local-slope/erosion-angle lean (vs. the global wind vector) deferred as a plant-diversity-slice candidate.
